critical_errors.issue: Proposition 9.8 of the [authoritative GK17 paper](https://gubler.app.uni-regensburg.de/Publikationen/1406.7637.pdf) proves uniqueness for a generalized delta-form satisfying the residual-current identity after every algebraic pullback. The lemma instead asserts uniqueness merely from having the residual associated current on W. Since Proposition 6.8 explicitly requires equality after all pullbacks and the current map is not asserted to be injective, the cited result does not justify this stronger uniqueness claim.

The Hessian-lift equation gives gamma|Trop(U) = d'_P d''_P phi_e only on trop_U(V), but the proof wedges this identity with delta_C for arbitrary C = Trop(U) intersected with the chosen ambient open set. No assumption ensures C is contained in trop_U(V). Consequently gamma wedge delta_C need not equal (d'_P d''_P phi_e) wedge delta_C, so the displayed ambient representative is false as stated.
